config.note: Priorities mirror search.INTENT_PRIORITY (safety/emergency=100, medical=90, children/special_needs=80, others=10). Candidates are per-path ranked (article_id, score); rank = list position.

scenarios.query: i have a high fever, where is the nearest doctor
scenarios.note: Location path scores doc 20 highest, but the medical tier outranks it; doc 10 (in both paths) leads the medical tier.

scenarios.query: is it safe here and where are the toilets
scenarios.note: Safety must not be buried beneath a much higher-scoring facilities result.

scenarios.query: when is food served and what are the schedule times
scenarios.note: Same-priority tier: RRF + tie-break (best_path_rank, then article_id asc) decides; doc 50 and 60 tie on RRF, doc 50 wins on article_id.
